title: Data Analytics / Business Intelligence
description: Data Analytics / Business Intelligence covers analytics strategy and data literacy through warehousing, ETL, SQL, OLAP, dashboards, statistics, predictive analytics, ML basics, big data, and governance, closing with self-service BI, performance management, and a portfolio-ready capstone.

topics.title: Analytics Strategy and Decision Intelligence

children.title: Conceptual Foundations of Analytics Strategy and Decision Intelligence
children.description: This subtopic gives students the core language and mental models needed to reason about the topic before choosing tools or methods.

children.title: Methods and Tools for Analytics Strategy and Decision Intelligence
children.description: This subtopic turns the idea into repeatable professional practice through models, workflows, artifacts, and technical tools.

children.title: Applied Business Use of Analytics Strategy and Decision Intelligence
children.description: This subtopic emphasizes how the topic changes decisions, systems, risks, adoption, and measurable organizational outcomes.
